prompt:
Revise the supplied GitHub Manager RAG illustration into a new version that shows the full provenance of BOTH evidence and canonical-label context. Keep the established clean paper-and-marker style: white paper, dark navy irregular pen outlines, indigo/blue headings, restrained purple and soft blue/lavender washes, friendly semantic document/robot/reviewer illustrations. NO tables/furniture, plants, room scenery, generic architecture boxes or decorative clutter. Preserve the three main stages Retrieval, Augment, Generate. You may expand to a roomy landscape 3:2 canvas, target 2400x1600, to keep essential labels readable rather than cramming them into the old composition.
Keep title "GitHub Manager: RAG in practice". RESTORE the first illustration's exact subtitle: "Fixed, single-pass retrieval-augmented classification". Beneath it, restore the short descriptor "Sparse label retrieval + durable application memory".
The old figure omitted source evidence selection and the origins of the registry. The new illustration must explicitly show both. Use TWO CLEARLY SEPARATED illustrated bands, an earlier vocabulary-building band and the main RAG classification band. Both bands must fit with generous whitespace. Short labels, big semantic objects, clear arrowheads.
EARLIER BAND, caption "Earlier: build the canonical registry". A repository COLLECTION's metadata and README documents go through a small explicitly named "Evidence Parser" (local passage selection) and separate "RAKE" phrase extraction, yielding a compact collection booklet labeled "Collection evidence + phrases". That feeds a small "Taxonomy LLM" returning a paper marked "Draft". Then a distinct human reviewer with a pencil, labeled "Review & publish", produces the open notebook "Canonical registry". It must be obvious the parser does not directly approve labels or assign canonical IDs. Beneath the registry show short contents "IDs · kinds · names · definitions · aliases" and four independent tabs "Domain", "Project", "Topic", "Tag", without falsely making all four a linear hierarchy. This is an earlier prerequisite, not another LLM call for each classification.
MAIN BAND is the dominant story and has three main heading areas:
"1 Retrieval" with purpose "Select evidence + find labels"; "2 Augment" with purpose "Build the model context"; "3 Generate" with purpose "Select supported IDs".
RETRIEVAL must have TWO visibly distinct operations:
A. Source evidence selection: this repository's "Metadata + README" documents feed a clearly named "Evidence Parser". A local deterministic parsing tool/pencil highlights source passages and outputs ordered slips "E0: metadata" and "E1+: README passages". This is local parsing and section selection, not semantic vector search or another LLM summary. The resulting evidence has a DIRECT illustrated route into augmentation, labeled "Compact evidence", so it does NOT appear that everything reaches the model only through canonical candidates.
B. Canonical label lookup: ALL retained evidence is the query to a magnifying glass explicitly named "Canonical Retriever", together with the EARLIER approved canonical registry. Caption exactly "TF-IDF + alias boost". Its output is "Candidate definitions" for "Project · Topic · Tag". Draw those shortlisted definitions into augmentation as a second separate incoming route. Do not draw the full registry as a direct unfiltered model input. The registry-to-retriever arrow must be explicit, labeled "Approved vocabulary", with a clear route avoiding crossings with the source-evidence route.
A SMALL SEPARATE RAKE phrase-extraction cue reads the parsed evidence and feeds a third short route "RAKE phrases" into augmentation. RAKE phrases are NOT the query to TF-IDF. If the stage becomes crowded, combine evidence selection and its RAKE cue visually but preserve these three labeled inputs to augmentation: compact evidence, phrases, candidates.
AUGMENT: show an open request booklet "User JSON" holding three large readable inserts "Compact evidence", "RAKE phrases", "Candidate definitions". Small separate tabs "System prompt" and "Output schema". Keep the evidence route and candidate route unambiguously distinct as they enter this booklet. Only selected source passages and shortlisted label definitions go here, not all saved state.
GENERATE: a small friendly "LLM" robot reads the assembled request, then a structured output paper "Classification" shows only schematic headings "Canonical IDs", "Evidence IDs", "Confidence + reason". No invented values, scores, benchmark claims or issue labels. Below generation a small clipboard and human reviewer labeled "Then validate & review"; local check caption "Schema + ID checks" so a valid evidence ID is not mistaken for a proof of semantic support.
A quiet footer, without furniture, reads "Saved application state: profiles · taxonomy · decisions · receipts". Do not draw a model-controlled retrieval loop, memory retriever, embeddings or reranker.
Content priority: restore exact subtitle; Evidence Parser is visible inside the broad Retrieval stage; show upstream registry creation through taxonomy draft and human publication; route parsed evidence DIRECTLY to augmentation, and registry via Canonical Retriever/candidates to augmentation. All three inputs to augmentation must be visible. Make these relationships more important than decorative detail. Keep labels readable at intended 1200px display width.
